thread:
oncall-bot: Paging: high paging/OOM signals on runtime-gpu-pool-3 — auto-escalation triggered 00:00 UTC. Instance group: gpu-nvlink-48.

sophia: seeing >80% tail latency on hosted inference, lots of aborted requests. paging spikes around 00:02. oncall taking.

raj: joining. can you paste the VM/gpu mem stats and kvcache metrics? also any recent config rollouts?

sophia: paste logs snippet:```
[00:01:58] runtime: evicting kv entries: count=124k, reclaimed=48MB
[00:02:01] gpu0 mem_used=41532MiB mem_total=49152MiB free=760MiB
[00:02:02] page_fault: host_swap_triggered=1
[00:02:03] OOM_killer: invoked for process: inference-worker pid=3245
```

matt: confirmed batchers show larger average batch (~12 -> 18 tokens per batch) since 23:50; client traffic pattern changed (long prompts).

lia: customer-impact: two customers reported 5xx on hosted endpoint /v1/generate — CS open ticket #9871, affected ~30 requests/min for ~6 minutes.\\n

cs-eli: ticket notes — high priority, impacted app trial users. sent mitigation guidance (retry/backoff).

raj: hypothesis1: KV cache growth + larger batches pushed per-GPU working set above quantized limits -> fragmentation then paging. hypothesis2: a long-running request pinned a large KV set preventing eviction.

sophia: collected more metrics: KV cache entries per-model: model-a=1.8M, model-b=250k. avg_kv_entry_size=32B. kvcache mem footprint ~58GB out of 64GB reserved (per-GPU).

ops-bot: autoscaler: scale_up request issued to dedicated-pool-3 at 00:03; new node provisioning ETA 4m.

matt: did we have any recent quantization/compilation changes? I see a tiny rollout to quant-profile-v2 at 23:45 for stage subset.

lia: customer call scheduled at 00:10 to explain and give ETA.

raj: quick triage actions: 1) temporary reduce kvcache.max_entries for model-a to 1.2M (evict older prefixes) 2) cap batch size at router to 12 3) enable kvcache aggressive-evict mode on pool-3. who can run?

sophia: I'll push the kvcache cap and enable aggressive-evict on the affected hosts now. Pushing small router policy to cap batch at 12 (will drop if necessary).

sophia: command run:```bash
# reduce kvcache entries
redwoodctl patch node-pool/gpu-pool-3 --set kvcache.max_entries.model-a=1200000
# router cap
redwoodctl patch routing/global --set generation.max_batch_size=12
```

matt: noted extra rollouts: quant-profile-v2 flagged; I'm rolling back that flag on the small stage subset to avoid new kernel paths.```bash
redwoodctl rollback rollout quant-profile-v2 --scope=staging-smallset
```

ops-bot: action logged: [kvcache cap applied] [router cap applied] [quant rollback initiated].

sophia: immediate telemetry after changes: gpu0 free went from 760MiB -> 6.2GiB within 45s, tail latency dropped ~65%. paging events decreased.

raj: good. keep monitor for 10m. collect full timeline for RCA: pre-incident (23:40-00:00) traffic change, rollout of quant-profile-v2 23:45, batch growth 23:50+, incident 00:01, mitigation 00:03-00:05.

lia: customer update: initial mitigation applied, ETA to full recovery 05m. CS updated ticket #9871.

matt: collecting kernel logs from gpu nodes and compiling per-process mem maps. attaching gist: https://internal.gists/redwood/4628/gpu-mem-dump-00-02

sophia: pushed timeline snapshot to incident doc: https://redwood.incid/4628-run-oom-draft. adding memory histograms and KV growth curve.

raj: hypothesis refinement: primary cause is KV cache pressure (model-a) amplified by temporary kernel allocation change from quant-profile-v2 that increased per-activation working set. fragmentation caused host swap; OOM killed active worker. Secondary cause: a sudden traffic shift increased average batch lengths.

lia: action items for RCA: - full kvcache sizing audit for model-a - add soft cap/auto-throttle when kvcache>80% - improve rollback gating for quant profile changes - add preflight sim for batch distribution impact

ops-bot: new task created: INC-4628-RA1 assigned to raj, due 2026-03-25.

cs-eli: customers informed; they accepted root-cause summary and asked for postmortem.

sophia: closing live mitigation. will keep thread open for RCA write-up. thanks all. :thumbsup:

raj: leaving notes: include raw dumps (gpu mem maps), router batch histogram, kvcache evict logs, rollout history. point to /playbooks/paging-mitigation for suggested runbook updates.

matt: also recommend adding an alert: kvcache_utilization > 85% + batch_size_p50>15 -> auto-cap batch and notify oncall.

lia: adding CS follow-up: update SLA impact report and share with customer tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Incident incident-4628 marked mitigated by oncall at 00:07 UTC.

sophia: end of live thread.
